title: Privacy
intro: What this website does with your information, in plain words.

sections.title: On your device
sections.text: Your bag, wishlist, recently viewed pieces, saved details and order numbers are stored in your own browser. You can clear them at any time from My Revasser.

sections.title: When you order
sections.text: When you place an order, the details you type are saved in our private order sheet, kept in our Google account, so we can confirm, deliver and support your order. We do not sell them, and share only what a delivery service needs to bring your order to you.

sections.title: Website hosting
sections.text: Our hosting provider processes standard technical information, such as IP addresses, to deliver and protect the site.

sections.title: Your choices
sections.text: Email {email} to ask what order information we hold, or to have it corrected or deleted.
